description: Kiosk Satellite shows the Kitchen Morning dashboard (Meridian morning forecast) as its screensaver 5:30-8:00 am. KS widgets draw over every screensaver mode, so they go off for that slot and back on for the photos. It also shows KS's At a glance row (today's forecast, rain chance, rain mm, UV) only during the morning weather screen, through rest_command.ks_kitchen_settings, because the row is global and has no HA switch.
